tasks.label: Harness: preflight
tasks.command:
set -e; printf '[status snapshot]
'; git status --short --branch; printf '
[rt heads]
'; printf 'linux-orangepi-rt '; git -C ../linux-orangepi-rt rev-parse --short HEAD; if [[ -r kernel/orange-pi-6.1-rk35xx-rt/.git/HEAD ]]; then printf 'build-copy '; cut -c1-12 kernel/orange-pi-6.1-rk35xx-rt/.git/HEAD; else echo 'build-copy MISSING'; fi; printf '

'; timeout 10s bash -n userpatches/customize-image.sh; printf '

'; timeout 15s bash -n userpatches/overlay/usr/local/sbin/opibot-runtime-mode userpatches/overlay/usr/local/sbin/opibot-performance-mode userpatches/overlay/usr/local/sbin/opibot-irq-layout userpatches/overlay/usr/local/sbin/opibot-boot-profile-sync

tasks.label: Harness: gate-b audit pack
tasks.command:
set -e; printf '[customize-image hotspots]
'; timeout 10s rg -n '^([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\(\)' userpatches/customize-image.sh; printf '
[runtime chain]
'; timeout 15s rg -n 'LEGACY|RUNTIME_RT_TUNE|ACTIVE_TARGET|BOOT_PROFILE|apply-config|watch|runtime-rt-tune|opibot-performance-mode' userpatches/overlay/usr/local/sbin/opibot-runtime-mode userpatches/overlay/usr/local/sbin/opibot-performance-mode userpatches/overlay/usr/local/sbin/opibot-irq-layout userpatches/overlay/usr/local/sbin/opibot-boot-profile-sync userpatches/overlay/etc/systemd/system/opibot-runtime-mode.service userpatches/overlay/etc/systemd/system/opibot-runtime-autoswitch.service userpatches/overlay/etc/systemd/system/opibot-irq-layout.service

tasks.label: Harness: runtime issue snapshot
tasks.command:
set -e; printf '[mode mapping]
'; timeout 10s rg -n 'control-active|perception-active|standby|rt-high-performance|low-power' userpatches/overlay/usr/local/sbin/opibot-runtime-mode userpatches/overlay/usr/local/sbin/opibot-performance-mode userpatches/overlay/etc/default/opibot-runtime-mode userpatches/overlay/etc/default/opibot-performance-mode userpatches/overlay/etc/default/opibot-boot-profile; printf '
[boot arg writers]
'; timeout 10s rg -n 'extraargs=|orangepiEnv.txt|nohz_full|rcu_nocbs|isolcpus|irqaffinity' userpatches/customize-image.sh userpatches/overlay/usr/local/sbin/opibot-boot-profile-sync; printf '
[cpu list parsers]
'; timeout 10s rg -n 'cpulist_to_mask|expand_cpulist|cpu list|tr ' userpatches/overlay/usr/local/sbin/opibot-performance-mode userpatches/overlay/usr/local/sbin/runtime-rt-tune
